page.layout: One page, a title page. Centred title block at the top: a spaced capitals line, then a larger line, then a small italic-type line and several smaller lines, with a short block of centred lines below, then a printer's imprint at the foot. Show-through of mirrored text from the reverse runs through the upper and middle part of the page and is not transcribed.
